result.fundName: Axis Small Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Axis Small Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth marginally outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 0.13% (23.52% vs 23.39%).
Chance of beating benchmark is 64.9% — moderate consistency, below the 70% Golden Triangle threshold.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.11 vs benchmark 0.72, Sortino 1.31.
Defensive profile: beta 0.70 with 23% lower volatility than the benchmark.
Positive alpha of 7.08% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.33).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -34.64% vs benchmark -59.78%.
Rolling return range spans -14.62% to 100.71% (115.33 pp spread) — consistency score 79.
Failed criteria: Chance of Beating Benchmark.
